interface.shortDescription: Stories, games, and creative project craft
interface.longDescription: Route stories, TTRPG campaigns, board and video game concepts, horror, Story Atlas preparation, canon, provenance, and publishing to focused skills. TTRPG Compass can supply optional table inspiration and source-labeled rules lookups when available. Career, grant, academic, novelist app, and teaching workflows remain separate.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose the structure of this story and preserve its canon.
Revise this horror scene without losing the character's voice.
Prepare these campaign notes as a reviewable Story Atlas.
Turn this TTRPG idea into playable GM prep with clear player and GM boundaries.
